Program Overview McKesson's Intern program is designed to provide: • A real-life working environment • A solid foundation of experience and hopeful offer of full-time employment • A cohort experience with other interns Consistent senior leadership exposure and learning experiences. • We are looking for candidates who have: • Willingness to learn, develop, and contribute to a fun, demanding, fast-paced environment. • Self-starter that brings both interpersonal skills abilities to identify a problem then solve it. Passion and enthusiasm for healthcare and our customers' success • Work Term: Summer 2026- May 4th through August 28th Location: Saint-Laurent, QC, CAN - 4705 Dobrin Street (Hybrid) Job Responsibilities: • Analyze small application requests, enhancements, and intake items from business and IT stakeholders • Translate business needs into clear functional requirements and solution options • Design and develop lightweight applications, prototypes, scripts, or automations (as appropriate) • Support testing, validation, and documentation of delivered solutions • Perform impact analysis on existing applications and processes • Assist with backlog grooming, prioritization, and status reporting Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business teams to ensure solutions meet expectations • We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets.
